name: java-code-standards
description: A coordinated set of four skills and one rule that enforce a consistent Java coding standard. The three code skills (coding-guidelines, cognitive-driven-development, coupling-analysis) must always be used together when writing or changing Java code. coverage-driven-test-generation runs after code changes to maintain JaCoCo coverage. The code-standard.md rule provides the Definition of Done and is auto-loaded for all .java files.
